Modern.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the slab (the cold marble fishmonger's display) and the scale (the trade tool, and the fish itself). Counter to Wet Counter (less ownable as a mark) and Pike & Place Fish Co. (borrows the Pike Place Market name, which while geographic risks confusion). Slab & Scale names two trade objects plainly.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern fishmongering has moved from supermarket fish counters back to dedicated neighborhood shops with daily-landed fish and a clear sourcing list. The opening is for a brand that names the counter and the trade tool plainly.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Greenpoint Fish & Lobster (greenpointfish.com) plays the modern shop peer. Monger's (mongers.co.uk) holds the UK reference. Russ & Daughters (russanddaughters.com) is the heritage middle. We sit as a trade-noun-named modern fish counter.
Modern.positioningStatement: Slab & Scale is a modern neighborhood fishmonger named for the cold slab and the fish scale.

targetAudience.primary: Home cooks 30-55 who plan dinners around what landed that morning and want to know the boat and the day.
behaviors: Check the day's catch list before shopping
Ask about the boat and the dock
Re-buy weekly from a trusted counter

dos: Publish the day's catch by 7 a.m.
Name the boat and the dock
Show the slab, ice and all
donts: Photograph the fish on a styled plate

Modern.logoDirection: Wordmark: SLAB & SCALE set in a precise grotesk, one line, ampersand drawn slightly heavier. Small mark: a single fish-scale shape used on the wrapping paper.

typography.primary: GT America for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: GT America Mono for the day's catch list and prices
typography.rationale: One grotesk family plus its mono — the catch-board register.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: Anchor: Billingsgate Market — London's wholesale fish market, chartered in 1699, the historical reference point for the UK fishmonger trade. Billingsgate is a place name, not a registered brand in this trade. Counter to Toyosu Select (closer to the active brand of the modern Tokyo market) and Oyster & Ice (loses the heritage register). Billingsgate House uses the geographic place plainly.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury fishmongering is a small concierge category — daily-sourced wet fish, oysters, and shellfish delivered to restaurants, hotels, and private kitchens. The buyer is a head chef, a private-kitchen manager, or a long-standing private client.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Browns of Brockley (brownsofbrockley.com) plays the considered shop peer. Wright Brothers (thewrightbrothers.co.uk) holds the heritage-supply middle. Murray's Fish Market (limited reference) sits in the heritage-American slot. We sit as a Billingsgate-heritage concierge supplier.
Luxury.positioningStatement: Billingsgate House is a concierge fishmonger and wet-fish supplier in the Billingsgate Market lineage, serving restaurants, hotels, and private kitchens.

targetAudience.primary: Head chefs, private-kitchen managers, and long-standing private clients ordering daily fish by phone or standing order.
behaviors: Call by 5 a.m. for same-day adjustments

dos: Address chefs and clients by name
Name the boat, the dock, and the morning
Print the day's catch on hand-laid paper
donts: Photograph the fish on lifestyle plates

Luxury.logoDirection: Wordmark: BILLINGSGATE HOUSE set in a refined English serif, two lines centered. A hallmark — a single fish silhouette over a small London-stone shape — used on the delivery card and the wax seal.

typography.primary: Caslon for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Garamond Premier Pro for body and client letters
typography.rationale: Two classical English serifs — the Billingsgate-heritage register.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the fin — the part of the fish, and the cinematic word for the end. Counter to Catch (verb-as-noun, less ownable) and Salt (closer to preservation than fishmongering). The full stop closes the wordmark.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal fishmongering brands serve the design-literate home cook who wants the day's catch posted plainly. The opening is for a single-syllable trade-noun brand with no theater.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Greenpoint Fish & Lobster (greenpointfish.com) plays the considered-modern peer. Monger's (mongers.co.uk) holds the UK reference. Fishwife (fishwifeseafoods.com) is the modern packaged middle. We sit as the punctuated single-word minimal option.
Minimal.positioningStatement: Fin. is a minimal neighborhood fishmonger — one counter, one day's catch, one rate card.

targetAudience.primary: Home cooks 28-45 wanting today's catch posted plainly and no nautical decoration.
behaviors: Check the daily catch list online

dos: Publish the day's catch on the home page
Confirm the order in one line

Minimal.logoDirection: Wordmark: FIN. set very large in a clean modern sans, three letters and a full stop. No symbol.

typography.primary: ABC Diatype for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: ABC Diatype Mono for the daily catch list
typography.rationale: Clean Diatype with its mono — the single-counter register.

Corporate.brandNameRationale: Anchor: 'coastal fisheries' — the standard trade phrase for regional fish-supply operations. Counter to Marlow Fish Holdings (uses a surname-place that risks reading as a real firm) and Harbor & Hook Seafood (closer to creative-corporate hybrid). Coastal Fisheries Co. is a plain trade phrase with a corporate suffix.
Corporate.industrySummary: Corporate fishmongering operates across multi-region wholesale supply, hotel and restaurant programs, and grocery wet-counter contracts. The buyer is a procurement officer, an executive chef, or a grocery wet-counter category manager.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: Pacific Seafood (pacificseafood.com) plays the multi-region peer. Sysco Seafood (sysco.com) holds the at-scale broadline reference. Wright Brothers (thewrightbrothers.co.uk) is the heritage-supplier middle. We sit as a regional multi-site wholesale fisheries operator.
Corporate.positioningStatement: Coastal Fisheries Co. is a multi-region wholesale fishmonger and wet-fish supplier serving restaurants, hotels, and grocery wet-counter programs.

targetAudience.primary: Procurement officers, executive chefs, and grocery wet-counter category managers across mid-sized operators.
behaviors: Renew on annual terms with quarterly reviews

dos: Lead with multi-region delivery capacity and certifications
Speak to procurement and category buyers
donts: Run consumer-facing campaigns at the parent level

Corporate.logoDirection: Wordmark: COASTAL FISHERIES CO. set in an institutional serif, three lines centered. A small mark — a single fish silhouette over a wave-rule — used on the contract cover.

typography.rationale: A reading serif plus a clean grotesk — the wholesale-fisheries register.

Creative.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the fishmonger's apron (heavy rubber, ice-stained, the trade uniform) and the slab (the cold marble display). Counter to Gills & Tides (closer to lifestyle imagery) and Iceberg Counter (loses the trade register). The Apron & Slab is the paired-noun trade phrase that lives on a sign.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative fishmonger brands sit between the heritage shop and the modern packaged-seafood brand. The opening is for a paired-noun brand named for the apron and the slab — the trade uniform and the trade display.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Russ & Daughters (russanddaughters.com) plays the heritage-creative peer. Greenpoint Fish & Lobster (greenpointfish.com) holds the modern middle. Fishwife (fishwifeseafoods.com) is the packaged-modern reference. We sit as a paired-noun creative fishmonger.
Creative.positioningStatement: The Apron & Slab is a creative neighborhood fishmonger named for the fishmonger's apron and the cold marble slab.

targetAudience.primary: Home cooks 28-50 who treat the fishmonger as a weekly stop and care about the maker behind the counter.
behaviors: Buy the same fish from the same person weekly

dos: Name the monger on every catch board
Write the daily list in the monger's voice
Show the apron and the slab as the brand's visual hook

Creative.logoDirection: Wordmark: THE APRON & SLAB set in a warm display serif with a hand-drawn ampersand. Small mark: an apron-and-slab silhouette used as the shop stamp.

typography.rationale: A warm display serif plus a clean grotesk — the neighborhood-shop register.
